about: Conservation laws and sanity principles the FlowWorks kernel must obey at the settings it SHIPS. Each law names the fuzz family of src/RimMandrake/Utils/vv_shipped_matrix.py that checks it and the exact assertion text in source; each family names a planted break that must turn it red (python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/vv_laws.py prove FlowWorks).

laws.sentence: The kernel's own ledger balances on every pulse: what it records moving in equals what it records moving out.
Water is conserved: total volume after a pulse equals the volume before, plus declared external input (rain, limitless sources), minus what sinks drained.
Every decilitre a sink drains is accounted to a sink cell that held it at the start of the pulse.
Each fluid is conserved on its own: no pulse turns one fluid into another.
No negative or overfilled cell: 0 <= fill <= depth <= 4 everywhere, every pulse.
A cell's exact water is never negative and never above its brim (depth x U decilitres).
A finite liquid body is never debited below zero: its stock stays >= 0.
With its inputs exhausted or steady, a scene settles: after the longest viscosity stride twice over it holds one state for 24 more pulses (no shuttle).
A level never may flow to its own cell (the flow order is irreflexive).
No pair of cells may each flow into the other (a level would shuttle).
Choosing between two different candidates always prefers exactly one of them.

check.text: PrefersCandidate not a strict total order

laws.sentence: A converter never runs more batches than its input, output room and accrued budget allow, and never leaves an affordable batch unrun.
A converter's accrued budget never goes negative.
Input consumed and output produced keep the recipe's ratio exactly.
No three cells may each flow into the next and back to the first (no 3-cycle).
A limitless water source fills every excavated cell connected to it through excavated cells, given time.

check.text: connected to a limitless source ends

laws.sentence: A random 8x8 surface scene comes to rest: its water stops changing by pulse 150 of 200, with no shuttle of any period.

check.text: [a surface scene never came to rest]

laws.sentence: A surface scene conserves its water to the decilitre: cells plus pond stock plus what the sinks drained stays constant, and the kernel's ledger balances every pulse.

check.text: [a surface scene did not conserve its water]

laws.sentence: In a sinkless surface scene at rest, no wet cell stands 3 or more decilitres of surface above a dug neighbour.

check.text: [a settled surface scene kept a wet step]

laws.sentence: After any sequence of digging, filling in, supplying, pumping, pouring, burning, refilling and rain, every cell's fill stays between zero and its depth, and its depth at most superdeep (4).
A cell holds a fluid exactly when it is wet: no wet cell without a fluid, no dry cell with one.

check.text: wet without a fluid or dry with one

laws.sentence: A cell that is wet before and after one action holds the same fluid: fluids never mix.
A limited water body's stock never goes below zero.
A limited water body's stock never rises above its capacity.

Per fluid, what the cells, limited bodies and tanks hold equals what they started with plus every declared input (limitless supply, refill, rain) minus every declared loss (overflow, burning, what a limitless body takes back).
Filling every cell back in returns the ground to depth 0 and fill 0.
A body takes back exactly the levels CreditableLevels promised it would take.
A body that may supply one unit may also be debited that unit, and the reverse: a source never stutters.
Burning neither loses nor invents ticks: the levels due times the ticks per level, plus what is carried, equals the ticks added.
A pit's measured width at a cell is the side of the widest square of superdeep cells holding that cell.

check.text: but the widest all-superdeep block holding

laws.sentence: Digging one more cell superdeep never makes a pit narrower anywhere.
A hose install is allowed when the shortest route from the reel, pulled taut and given its 5% margin, fits the hose.

check.text: (the length-bounded search missed a route that fits)

laws.sentence: A hose install is refused when the shortest route from the reel, pulled taut and given its 5% margin, is longer than the hose.
An install that an unbounded route search cannot reach is refused as having no route.

check.text: install: unbounded search finds no route but CheckInstall said

laws.sentence: Laying the same hose twice with the same seed gives the same hose.

check.text: Lay twice with one seed gave different hoses

laws.sentence: A laid hose starts at the reel's mouth and ends at the target cell's centre.
A laid hose is never longer than the hose.

check.text: G1 laid hose longer than the hose

laws.sentence: A laid hose, flat or plump, never runs through a wall.

After every action on a reel's hose its carry invariants hold: Carrying exactly when someone carries it, a winder exactly when a hand wind runs, a trail of at least one cell outside Stored and none in Stored, a pulled length within the hose, and a laid or dropped hose's far end on the trail's last cell.
Walking with a carried hose never pulls it longer than the hose.

check.text: trail: stepping stretched the hose past its length

laws.sentence: A carried hose's trail stays attached to the reel's mouth.

check.text: trail: pulled hose is detached from the reel mouth

laws.sentence: A carried hose's trail reaches the cell it ends in.

check.text: trail: pulled hose does not reach the end cell

laws.sentence: No cell appears twice on a carried hose's trail.

check.text: trail: a cell appears twice on the trail

laws.sentence: A carried hose's trail never runs through a wall.

check.text: trail: the pulled hose runs through a wall

laws.sentence: Winding a hose in never reduces how much is wound.
An interrupted wind never leaves the hose longer than before.

check.text: trail: interrupted wind lengthened the hose

plant.name: volume
plant.what: one decilitre of water (the kernel's smallest unit) appears from nowhere in a wet cell before a pulse

plant.name: bounds
plant.what: a dug cell's depth is set to 5 before a pulse

plant.name: shuttle
plant.what: one level is moved back and forth between two neighbouring wet cells on alternate pulses (volume and bounds kept)
equal depths may flow: the order becomes reflexive
batches are no longer capped by the input on hand
a limitless source's mouths are ignored: no limitless water enters a pit

plant.name: shuttle
plant.what: one decilitre is moved back and forth between a kept pair of wet cells on alternate pulses (volume and bounds kept)
a fill-in displaces one level too few: a full cell raised by one level keeps a fill above its new brim

plant.find: for (int ox = x - w + 1; ox <= x; ox++)
plant.replace: for (int ox = x - w + 1; ox < x; ox++)
plant.what: the width search skips every square whose right edge is the cell itself, so a lone superdeep cell reads width 0

plant.find: if (len * RouteMargin > maxLength) return "route too long";
plant.what: an install whose route is longer than the hose is allowed
a step is refused only past twice the hose's length, so walking stretches the hose
